zh: 最右边的故障字符永远不会被删除，它每秒向左吃掉一个字符；更左边的故障字符在被右边的故障字符吃掉之前，也在独立地向左吃。
因此可以按故障字符的位置把字符串切段：第一个故障字符前面长度为 p 的前缀需要 p 秒；相邻两个故障字符之间的间隔 g（右位置减左位置，包含左边那个故障字符本身）需要 g 秒；最后一个故障字符之后的后缀永远保留。各段同时进行，答案取最大值。
扫描字符串，previous 初值为 0；每遇到一个故障字符位置 i，用 i − previous 更新答案，然后令 previous = i；没有故障字符时答案为 0。
en: The rightmost failed service is never deleted and eats one character to its left every second; each failed service further left also eats leftward independently until the one on its right reaches it.

So split the string at the failed positions: the prefix of length p before the first failed service needs p seconds; the gap g between two consecutive failed services (right position minus left position, including the left failed service itself) needs g seconds; the suffix after the last failed service is never touched. All parts proceed at once, so the answer is the maximum.
Scan the string with previous = 0; at each failed position i, update the answer with i - previous and set previous = i; with no failed service the answer is 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Record the positions of the failed characters: take the maximum of the length before the first failure and the distances between adjacent failure positions; the suffix after the last failure is never deleted.

## Proof of correctness

The rightmost failure always remains and advances one step to the left every second; each failure further left independently works on the gap between the two before it is deleted by the failure to its right. A non-first gap of length g, which includes the left failure itself, takes g seconds to clear; the length p before the first failure takes p seconds. The gaps proceed in parallel, so the time is the maximum.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
